matrix_name.name: polyurethane
matrix_name.description: Cross-linked polyurethane (PU) network prepared from oligooxypropylene glycol (OPG) and tolylenediisocyanate (TDI) with trimethylolpropane (TMP) as crosslinking agent; composite prepared by ultrasonic dispersion of CNT in dichloromethane, then reaction molding/cure at 60 C.

fillers.name: carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: Multiwall carbon nanotubes (MWCNT), length 5–10 um, outer diameter 20 nm, surface area 190 m^2/g; introduced in situ; ultrasonic dispersion route.

fillers.name: iron(III) acetylacetonate
fillers.description: Fe(acac)3 coordination compound used as modifier (introduced at end as solution in dichloromethane).
